title: Power's Dru And Cane Tejada Bodied The Whole Castillo Family After Evelyn Castillo Threatened Monet Tejada
htmlContent:
In a shocking turn of events, episode nine of Power Book II: Ghost Season Three saw Dru Tejada and Cane Tejada team up to take out the entire Castillo family. The action unfolded after the Castillos threatened Monet Tejada, Dru and Cane's mother. In response, the two brothers took matters into their own hands and carried out a brutal attack on the Castillo family, killing them all.

As the killings were taking place, Evelyn Castillo revealed to Monet that she had been responsible for Lorenzo's death. According to Evelyn, Monet had ordered Gordo to kill Lorenzo after he found out that Lorenzo had given the order to kill Uncle Frank. This revelation added another layer of complexity to an already tense situation, and left viewers wondering how Monet would react to the news.

The episode ended with the shocking aftermath of the killings, as Dru and Cane were left to deal with the fallout of their actions. It remains to be seen how the rest of the season will play out, and how Monet will react to the news of Lorenzo's death. But one thing is for certain: the Tejada family is in for a wild ride as they navigate the fallout from this brutal attack on their rivals.
